title: How to learn any skill in 30 days using AI

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: What if I told you you could learn anything in 30 days?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: AI is changing how we master skills faster than ever before.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Use AI tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney to break down any skill step by step.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: These tools can generate personalized lesson plans and instant feedback.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Whether you're learning coding or painting, AI makes it accessible to everyone.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The key is consistency and using AI to stay on track every single day.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Ready to learn something new in just 30 days? Let me know in the comments!

caption_text: How to learn any skill in 30 days using AI
